svg.title: Electrons scattering from quarks in a proton
svg.desc: Five high-energy electrons enter a proton from the left. Two pass straight through. The other three strike the proton’s point-like quarks, two up quarks and a down quark, and are scattered through large angles, showing that the proton has internal structure. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Higher-energy electrons provide shorter probe wavelengths
Relativistic momentum sets λ = h/p. Wavelength drawing is clipped at both display limits; readouts
retain the physical value. Scattering resolution also depends on momentum transfer.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
